title: My Home Above
firstLine: There's a home beyond this body for the soul,

lines: There's a home beyond this body for the soul,
Where from God eternal blessings ever flow
'Tis a land some day my spirit shall behold
How I long to see that city made of gold
And to meet my Savior there.
I will rise with Jesus evermore to stay
In the land beyond the sky,
When the angels gently carry me away
To the Father's home on high.
In a house where glad hosannas ever ring,
I will make my home above
In immortal glory, ever more to sing
